title: Finite forget-support Chern equation on the diagonal surface
statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_finiteCartierChern
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)] (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (hδ : IsDiagonalLimit l Y hY D δ)
    (c : SpTowerClasses.Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y))
    (hn : c.Normalized l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)))
    (hc : SpTowerClasses.FiniteChernNormalization l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) c)
    (r : Restriction l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y))
    (k : Coefficients l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y) c r)
    (L : DiagonalRlim (DiagonalMod l (diagonalSurface Y))) (n : ℕ) :
    let E := ULift.{u} (Padic l)
    let U := diagonalCompletedUnderlying l (diagonalSurface Y)
    let V := r.F.mapDerivedCategory
    let ev := ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (DiagonalMod l (diagonalSurface Y))).obj
      (op n)).mapDerivedCategory
    U.map
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalCompleted l (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).map
          (completedSupportedUnit l Y) ≫ δ) ≫
      shiftedComparison U (V ⋙ L.R) (k.lineMap l E L) 2 ≫ (L.projection n).app _ =
        (k.unitMap l E L ≫ (L.projection n).app _) ≫
          ev.map (V.map (SpTowerClasses.firstChern l E c
            (SpTowerClasses.diagonalPic Y)))

proof.text: Project the whole-system equation in IsDiagonalLimit at n. The exact-cone projection identity, naturality and the single/shift comparisons identify the result with the evaluated supported Ext class, with source and root comparisons fixed by their generator and root-limit equations. Precompose the explicit completedSupportedUnit: its underlying one is the supported integral section one.

The finite-cycle normalization is the positive Cartier reduction at exponent n+1. Use the unique normalized Cartier reductions and their site comparison to identify its etale supported Kummer class. Forgetting support yields the Kummer Chern class of the dual actual diagonal ideal, by supported_kummer_chern_realization. This is diagonalPic Y.

Apply FiniteChernNormalization to diagonalPic Y at n. The coefficient-one, root-tensor and actual projection equations identify both endpoint maps with the preceding Kummer calculation. Chern.Normalized fixes the scalar units and shift comparisons. For the completed source, l-regularity and its actual finite quotient identify derived reduction of the regular completed unit with the finite constant unit, with unit the actual coefficient projection. Apply its reduction adjunction first, then the integral-to-finite scalar-unit Ext bijection to identify the coefficient-linear arrows from their integral adjuncts. The coefficient input is exactly k.unitMap followed by L.projection, by the exact-cone projection identity.
